verdict.rationale: Temporal's CLI ships a single command (temporal server start-dev) that stands up a full local dev service including UI, confirmed by docs and a runtime probe showing the CLI works locally; the TypeScript testing suite docs explicitly describe a test server supporting time-skipping for unit/integration testing workflows and workers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mocked-activity/step utilities beyond time-skipping, and independent hands-on confirmation of the testing suite's mocking capabilities.
